US Treasury yields ease after strong bond auction demand

US Treasury yields retreated from recent highs following a strong auction of 30-year bonds, which drew unexpectedly firm demand. The selloff in US bonds also eased, with yields moving off their peaks after the solid auction of 10-year notes eased concerns about demand. The 10-year Treasury yield backed off from a 24-year high.
